verdict.rationale: Veriff is an identity-verification API/SDK platform, not an AI agent or assistant that calls tools. Acting as an MCP client that plugs in external MCP servers is outside this product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Veriff ships any agent or MCP-client capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
